description: The repo was just initialised: futures.json only holds the init template's example. The user asks for a review only. Expected: notice the futures are a placeholder and generate them (explore skill) or say plainly that decisions would be guesses; review without committing. Review only, so no source changes.
prompt: Before I commit: review the staged reminders endpoint for coupling problems. Don't commit anything yet.

checks.label: replaced the placeholder futures, or flagged that they are missing

rubric: Noticed that futures.json only holds the init template's example future and said that without real futures the refactor-or-accept calls are guesses.
Generated futures with the explore skill (or proposed to, if it judged that out of scope) before deciding the findings.
Did not commit, and did not change source code or log decisions: it recommended them for the user to approve.
Gave a clear, short review: each finding the change adds or grows, the recommended decision, and why, tied to plausible changes.
